sources.label: Ad-free experience, UI cleanup, and MicroG-RE GmsCore notification support for M
sources.author: Tokudai
patch_list: Clean up Settings page
Removes plan info, referral cards, cancellation links, and blank dividers from the Settings screen.
GmsCore support
Enables push notifications, gate approvals, and e-Intercom on re-signed APKs using MicroG-RE (GmsCore).
Hide bottom navigation bar
Hides the bottom navigation bar and expands the main view full screen.
Remove ads
Removes banner ads, sponsored cards, ad SDK loaders, and neutralizes the VIP crown icon.
Remove home screen bloat
Hides community posts from the home screen and filters unused shortcuts from Quick Actions.
